question: On the Gesture Phase dataset, did XGBoost outperform TabNet?
expected_answer: Yes. XGBoost had a lower (better) cross-entropy loss than TabNet (80.64 vs 96.42; lower is better).

expected_source.paper: Shwartz-Ziv & Armon, Tabular Data: Deep Learning is Not All You Need

question: Which model had the best score on the Gesture Phase dataset?
expected_answer: Deep Ensemble w/ XGBoost (78.93 cross-entropy), narrowly ahead of XGBoost (80.64).

expected_source.paper: Shwartz-Ziv & Armon, Tabular Data: Deep Learning is Not All You Need
